grade.summary: ZOH handled the regression well: it sent the Sunday kickoff, check-in and follow-up with no Sunday recap, then a single Monday text that recapped the record, named the Sunday miss lightly, and ended with one defined step and one question. The main weaknesses are a slightly long kickoff and recap prose, and the recap leaves out the talk-test pace progress.
